scope: Detachable PCA9685 hub mounted above the converter; animation deferred

symmetric_male_headers.construction: Long metal ends on BOTH sides of the original plastic spacer; instructor-confirmed

donor_headers.purpose: Supply one additional six-position plastic spacer per symmetric header

assembly_relationships.mating_interface: Symmetric male pins beneath the hub plug into the female sockets on the carrier; not a soldered male-to-female joint.
assembly_relationships.clearance_target: Converter gold adjustment screw, including any hub underside solder/tails above it

placement.inference_evidence: Album photo 14 annotations A→X and 3→8; awaiting instructor confirmation

steps.condition: Only if the two end interconnect headers arrive soldered
steps.instruction: Desolder the factory end headers before fitting the height-adjusted replacement headers.
steps.before: Factory end headers present, or end holes already bare
steps.scope_note: Photos retain the 16 three-pin servo output connectors; those are not the replacement target.

steps.instruction: Remove a six-position plastic spacer from each of two donor headers using pliers.
Slide one extra spacer onto each symmetric long-on-both-sides six-pin male header, alongside its original spacer.
steps.before: One original spacer per symmetric header
steps.after: Two adjacent plastic spacers per header
steps.evidence: photo observation plus instructor correction identifying symmetric pins

steps.instruction: Fit the two modified male strips below the hub and solder their upper ends on its top face.
steps.after: Two male strips attached to hub, pointing downward
steps.unknown: Exact protrusion above hub and any trimming there

steps.instruction: Fit the female sockets over the downward male pins to check the detachable stack.
steps.evidence: photo observation; this temporary fitting is distinct from soldering

steps.instruction: Solder the female sockets to the carrier at the confirmed hole addresses.
steps.before: Female sockets not fixed to carrier
steps.after: Female sockets fixed to carrier; male-to-female interface remains detachable
steps.unknown: Exact alignment/fixturing order during soldering is not documented

steps.instruction: Seat the hub in its sockets and check that its underside and soldered tails clear the converter's gold screw.
inspection_views: side at gold screw for clearance
